name: Level Bands and advancement tracks
description: Class, prestige and total-character level progression use separate consecutive 20-level bands, not an independent hard-coded epic progression engine.

bands.example: Wizard 15 / Fighter 10 is in total-character Band 2 at level 25 while both individual classes remain in Band 1.

epicBoons.level19Default: ordinary ASI or otherwise eligible feat, not an automatic Epic Boon

unresolved: Silent-source band transition defaults, overlapping track effects, prestige spellcasting effective levels and paused or ended progression semantics.
